name: ptt
description: Local-first AI frontend with translation as a first-class citizen.

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.build:binary: npm run build:web && npm run assets && node scripts/build-binary.mjs
scripts.test: npm run assets && node scripts/check-architecture.mjs && vitest run
scripts.test:ui: npm run assets && vitest run --config vitest.ui.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run assets && tsc --noEmit && node scripts/check-i18n.mjs && node scripts/check-architecture.mjs && vitest run
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run test:ui
